title: Gold vs property: return, income and liquidity compared with RBI and market data
text:
Gold or property is usually argued on price growth alone. Income and liquidity change the picture.
Gold 24K: about ₹18,500 per 10 g in 2010 (BankBazaar) to ₹1,36,950 on 16 Nov 2026 (Goodreturns), with a ₹1,690 drop over a single weekend.
Housing: RBI's 18-city House Price Index fell 0.6% in Q2 2025-26 and rose 3.6% year on year in Q1 2026-27.
A home can yield rent but carries stamp duty (from 6% in Delhi) and months-long exits; gold sells in minutes and yields nothing while held.
How do you weigh liquidity against rental income when advising a family on where to park savings?
#RealEstate #PersonalFinance #Investing
